meta.title: NEXT — BitByBit Academy
meta.description: NEXT is a two-day experience to explore technology, AI and innovation while building an MVP and a path to keep learning.

hero.headline: Build what comes next.
hero.subtitle: Two days to explore ideas, build an MVP and discover real paths to keep learning.

intro.title: What is NEXT
intro.p1: NEXT is an experience for exploring technology, artificial intelligence and innovation by doing.
intro.p2: You arrive with curiosity. You leave with an MVP and a path to keep learning.
intro.quote: The future is understood by building it.
intro.p6: No experience is needed. Just the desire to start.

notOnlyAi.title: It is not only artificial intelligence.
notOnlyAi.body: NEXT is not about teaching a trendy tool. It helps students understand how technology is transforming every field and how they can use it to create, learn and make better decisions about their future.
notOnlyAi.quote: It does not matter what you study. What matters is what you build while you do it.

days.title: Two days. Understand + Build.
days.day1Body: A clear look at today's technology, AI and the opportunities they open.
days.day1Goal: See further. Choose better. Start with direction.
days.day2Body: Teams, tools and an idea turned into a prototype.

lists.day1: AI and new opportunities.|Emerging professions.|Real projects.|Questions and guidance.
lists.includes: Two-day experience.|Vocational and technology activation conversation.|Practical workshop.|Team project.|MVP or prototype.|Final presentation.|Digital material.|Catalog of free learning paths.|Follow-up guidance.|Certificate of participation.

flow.title: From idea to MVP.
flow.body: A simple path from thinking to building.

after.title: After NEXT
after.subtitle: The experience does not end on the second day.
after.body: NEXT also works as an entry point to free learning paths, digital credentials and introductory courses so students can continue developing skills after the event.

routes.title: Paths to keep building
routes.subtitle: Software. Hardware. AI. IoT. Robotics.
routes.body: After NEXT, students receive a continuity guide with free paths and selected resources according to their area of interest: programming, artificial intelligence, cloud, electronics, IoT, robotics, automation and intelligent systems.
routes.bridge: Programming builds the logic. Mechatronics connects that logic with the physical world.
routes.disclaimer: The paths mentioned belong to their respective official platforms. NEXT guides and connects students with available learning resources; credentials, badges or certificates are issued by each corresponding platform.

softwareAi.items: IBM SkillsBuild|IBM Z Xplore|Google Cloud Skills Boost|Microsoft Learn|BitByBit Academy|GitHub / GitHub Education

hardwareSmartSystems.title: Hardware & Smart Systems
hardwareSmartSystems.items: Arduino Education|Raspberry Pi Foundation|Wokwi|Edge Impulse|ARM Education|ESP32 / IoT projects|BitByBit Hardware Labs

continuity.title: An experience with continuity.
continuity.body: NEXT does not end with the final presentation. After the event, students receive guidance to keep learning through digital paths, free courses and resources selected according to their interests.

audience.title: Who is it for?
audience.body: For students curious about technology, AI, innovation or project creation.

initiator.title: About the initiator
initiator.name: José Manuel Cortés Cerón
initiator.role: Software Engineer · AI Researcher · Founder, BitByBit Academy
initiator.body: NEXT was born from a simple vision: bringing more young people closer to real learning, technology and innovation opportunities by connecting inspiration, practice and concrete paths for continuous learning.
